name: strauss-kb-docs
description: Documentation site for @saasontools/strauss-kb, deployed to GitHub Pages
author: Assaf Kamil
//: Deliberately NOT "type": "module", unlike every package in this repo. Webpack does not parse or replace require.resolveWeak() inside an ESM-scoped package (webpack#15775), and Docusaurus' generated SSR entry under .docusaurus/ inherits this package.json — so declaring ESM here fails the server bundle at build time. That is also why the flat ESLint config beside this file is eslint.config.mjs.
//nx: nx.json's targetDefaults give every build the `noMarkdown` input, which drops `{projectRoot}/**/*.md` from the task hash — right for the packages, wrong here: docs/**/*.md is exactly what `docusaurus build` compiles. So this target opts back in with `default` for its own files, while keeping `^noMarkdown` so a dependency's README still does not rebuild the site. Note the site's markdown is also deliberately absent from the repo's .nxignore.
